verdict.rationale: Muse documents event-driven automation of its own: once a goal or task is set, it keeps working on a schedule and in response to relevant events, taking next steps and following up (muse-docs-20). Goals are managed in a dedicated Goals tab (muse-docs-5), and it monitors and notifies after the app is closed (muse-docs-26). However, this is goal-driven agent behavior expressed in natural language, not explicit user-defined trigger→action rules, and many actions require approval first. missing for 10: explicit rule/trigger definition (event types, conditions, actions), documentation of which events can trigger actions, fully unattended execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
